licenseText.description: The full license/contract text, authored by the merchant. This is the single source of truth for what the buyer agreed to — it is what gets hashed and anchored via licenseGrantCid on catalog.listing and purchase.receipt. Nothing downstream interprets its contents structurally; any terms the merchant needs to convey (usage restrictions, territory, term length, attribution, etc.) belong in this text.

checkoutConsentRequired.description: If true, the purchasing application MUST obtain affirmative clickwrap consent before completing the transaction. Set to false for licenses where the grant is public and non-transactional.
